meta.description: See furniture from Azerbaijani companies in 3D and try it in your own room at real size.

hero.title: See it at home before you buy.
hero.subtitle: Spin furniture in 3D, place it in your room at real size with your phone, and check that it fits.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Find a piece you like in the catalog and look at it from every side in 3D.

steps.title: Try it in your room
steps.text: Place it in your room at real size with your phone. You'll see right away whether it fits.

steps.title: Talk to the company
steps.text: Message or call the company directly on WhatsApp. No middleman.

fit.hint: Enter the size of your free space — we'll only show what fits.

business.title: We bring your catalog into 3D and AR.
business.subtitle: Customers decide with more confidence once they've seen a piece at home.

models.title: True-to-size 3D models
models.text: From CAD files, photos or scans. Every model is fitted to the product's real dimensions.

link.title: One link, everywhere
link.text: Share it on your website, Instagram and WhatsApp. Works on iPhone and Android.

qr.title: QR codes for showrooms
qr.text: Customers scan the QR on the price tag and see the piece in their own home.

qa.title: Every model is checked
qa.text: Automated and manual review before anything goes live.

product.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'm interested in this product: {name} — {url}
product.contactNote: Orders, delivery and assembly are arranged directly with the company.
product.qrText: Point your phone camera at the QR code — the piece appears in your room at real size.

labels.hint: Print on A4 or save as PDF. Cut along the dashed lines.
